name: What should I do first after water gets into my walls, ceiling, or floors?
description: Shut off the source if safe, move valuables, and call for help immediately. The first 24–48 hours are critical for limiting mold and structural damage.

mainEntity.name: What should I do first after water gets into my walls, ceiling, or floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Act fast: shut off the water source if you can do so safely, move valuables out of the wet area, and call a restoration team right away. The first 24–48 hours matter because moisture can spread into drywall, flooring, and framing, which raises the risk of mold and structural damage.
